balls.text: slower one outside off stump, Nayar tries to carve it over the off-side field but makes no contact.
full pitched outside off, driven to right of KP at covers
Overpitched stuff and it has been dismissed to the off-side boundary. Duminy plays a very neat-looking drive over extra cover
the slower one well outside off, Duminy tries to slog it over midwicket and edges it through vacant slip region
he again fetches it from well-outside off, Vinay is bowling this over from round the stumps, mistimes the sweep shot to Kumble at square-leg
there is no deep midwicket in place for Nayar. vinay bowls it actually wide outside off, full toss though, and Nayar sweeps it to deep midwicket boundary! yeah he just swept it away.

Paddle scoop! Duminy moves towards off and scoops a really pacy full delivery over short fine-leg fielder! Oh well.. the times they have changed. Next time, may be, he will probably reverse sweep Steyn to the boundary
slower one, on the middle stump line, mistimes the pull past midwicket
forces the short-of-length delivery to deep point region
slower one, Duminy is forced to wait, he tries to force it to the on side, misses and the ball tails past the leg stump
slower one around the off stump line, dabbed to third man
the short-pitched delivery and Duminy immediately struggles, jabs it out past square-leg
fuller, edged away to square-leg
Crack of Doominy! Kallis keeps bowling length and keeps disappearing. Again, Duminy clears the front foot and thrashes it over the straight boundary
yorker length outside off, Duminy can't get bat to ball
Whack! He just cleared the front foot and smashed the length delivery high over long-off . Up up and over.
length delivery on the off stump line, swung away to wide long-on region
slower one around leg stump line, Duminy clears the front foot and swings it to deep backward square-leg boundary
eases this one through midwicket
Thwack! Duminy moves down the track and lifts it over long-off
taps this one past square-leg
moves down the track to ease it to long-on
leans forward to dab it to square-leg

Finally, the umpire has ended McLaren's misery. Bangalore dropped him twice but the umpire has given him out.  It was the slow off break on the middle and off line, McLaren went for the reverse sweep and was hit in front of the off and middle. It would have hit the off stump
quickish skidder outside off, Duminy tries to late cut but no wood on leather
turns in from outside off stump, forced away to long-on
loopy flighted delivery on the middle stump line, on driven to long-on
short in length outside off stump, chopped away for a single
from round the stumps, slow loopy delivery outside off stump, tapped to point
Jumbo! Plumb as it gets! Pollard had no clue. It was the slider, quickish, on the middle stump line, Pollard tries to work it across the line and is caught right in front. The crowd roar in delight.
the slow bouncer, Pollard shuffles to tuck it behind square-leg
turned past square-leg for a single
the slower one around the off stump line, tapped behind point for a single
Pulllllharrrdddddddd! Length delivery on the off stump line and Pollard has swung it cleanly over wide midwicket boundary. Violent Thump!
Drilled! Low full toss and KP has slammed it over the straight boundary
Top-edged six over fine-leg! It was the  bouncer outside off, Pollard went for the pull and top-edged it all the way!
walks down the track, Pankaj bangs it short down the leg side and Pollard goes for the pull but doesn't connect
slips this one down the leg side and McLaren glances it to the fine-leg boundary
ah! that slow googly where he almost collapses his front leg at release .. McLaren pushes it out
Flayed! It was tossed up full and McLaren hits it hard past Kumble .. it went at catchable height but it was too quick for Kumbles
the slow loopy googly arrives, whipped to left of deep midwicket where Manish makes a fine diving stop
quickish slider but goes down the leg side and Robin makes a half-stop
hits this one down to long-off
yorker! length just outside off and the ball squeezes under the bat and robin does well to stop it
the bouncer just outside off, Pollard sways away

Done in this time by the short one. Rayudu' shuffled across to the off side, Kallis had slipped in a 135 kmph short delivery around chest -high. Rayudu was caught on the shuffle, cramped for room and tried to swat it to the on side for a single but ended up shoveling it straight up .. entertaining knock comes to an end. Enter Pollard
Slashed away! Rayudu walks to the off side and slashes the fullish delivery to right of third man where Steyn makes a valiant diving effort but can't cut it off
banged in short and Rayudu, unlike few other Indian batsmen, likes to play the pull shot and has slammed this over midwicket
in the zone outside off, Rayudu tries to hit it on the up and is beaten
leans forward to dab it away

Dropped by Steyn What a clanger! It was another teasing googly from Kumble, again McLaren top-edged the slog sweep and Steyn, running from midwicket, seemed to have had it completely covered as he ran towards the ball and cupped his palms but he failed to hold on to what seemed a regulation catch really
moves to round the stumps, full length delivery on middle, tapped to extra cover
Thump! It was a full toss and it has been put away. He took couple of steps down the track and biffs the full toss over long-on
Thunderous wallop! Rayudu advances down the track and flays the leg break over long-on .. way back into the stands
What a slow googly ... .teasing McLaren who goes for the pull and mistimes it completely but he has the luck going his way ,.. the ball lands safely behind midwicket
gets forward to drive uppishly towards long-on
slow bouncer and McLaren allows it to pass him
shuffles across again, Steyn fires  in a yorker at 149 kmph .. Taufel reckons Rayudu got an inside edge on to his boot .. the ball rolled down to fine-leg . loud shout for lbw from Steyn
walks to the off side, receives a 149 kmph delivery jumping from short of length and he jabs it to short cover
banged in short, around 148 kmph, Rayudu sways away from the line of fire
fullish, around off stump line, driven to long-on
back of length delivery outside off stump, goes for the cut and gets an bottom edge on it

loud shout for lbw but it perhaps landed just outside leg. McLaren had gone down his knee to play the slog sweep and the ball rolled of his pad to third-man region .. Replays show that it pitched on the leg stump and would have hit the leg stump
quicker, just outside off, tapped to point region
goes well back to punch it towards deep midwicket for a single
on the middle stump line, slides in, flicked away behind square-leg
slower, tossed full on the middle and leg, McLaren is lured into flicking it across the line but the ball holds its line to take the leading edge to the of fside
leans forward to work this full delivery through midwicket
drives this one to left of mid-off where Kumble makes a tumbling diving stop. Acton-packed over comes to an end
Crash! Moves down the pitch and drives hard but the ball crashes into the stumps at the other end
dropped by Vinay at long-on Rayudu lofted the length delivery to long-on where Vinay jumped to his right but ended up palming the ball over the boundary!
Rayudu Garuuuuu! He charges down the track and wallops the back-of-length delivery over long-on! Crashed!
a high bouncer just outside off, Rayudu lets it go and Robin can't reach it

Flamboyant! Almost Calypso style! He shuffled to the off side, picked the full length delivery from outside off and lifted his front leg in the air as he played a delicious whippy uppish flick - a nice pick-up shot -to backward square-leg boundary
length delivery on the middle stump, Rayudu shuffles to the off and turns it to the midwicket region
moves towards the off stump and paddles the slow offcutter from the middle and leg line to the fine-leg boundary
charges down the track and crashes a length delivery hard but Manish Pandey intercepts at deep-cover region
the slower off cutter, outside off, pushed out to short cover
moves towards off, Kallis bangs it short outside leg, Rayudu goes for the pull but doesn't connect
outside off stump, short in length, forced away to sweeper cover
moves down the track for the big lofted hit but makes no contact. Robin collects
walks right across to the off - following the Tendulkar plan against Kallis - and glances it behind square-leg
good delivery, straightens on the middle stump line, cramps McLaren who was looking to dab it to the off side and it rolls off his thigh pad to the keeper
shuffles across, the slower off cutter moves past the glance and rolls off the thigh pad
works this length delivery to midwicket
the bouncer arrives and Rayudu ducks
punched away to wide third man region where Kaliis makes a sliding stop..
Dropped by DRavid at short midwicket. It was whipped straight at him but he has clanged it. In and out of his palms.

SRT's plan to walk to off and swing to leg against Kallis doesn't work today. He again moved towards off stump and this time it was a full-length delivery which he swung high towards deep square-leg .. Taylor rushed to his right and lunged out to take a very good catch
length delivery on the off and middle, pushed out to mid-on
on the middle and leg, tapped behind square-leg
walks to the off-side again and goes for another pull shot; connects well this time but Ross Taylor moves to his left near the boundary to make a fine lunging stop
shuffles to the off side for a pull shot and doesn't connect all that well .. will get couple of runs
off cutter around off and middle stump line, dabbed to right of backward point
on the leg stump line, straightening, moves past the attempted clip shot and rolls off the pad
Pankaj had delivered this from over the wicket and McLaren reached across to lift the length delivery over wide mid-off region
from round the stumps, full in length and moving in, McLaren goes for another slog across the line and edges it to his pad
short in length on the middle and leg, clipped past square-leg
Slog and a miss. He went for a big heave-ho to the on side and the length delivery tailed past the outside edge
slips this one down the leg side, he was trying the slower one around 111 kmph, wide
KP! what a stop. The crowd roar. It was driven to his right at covers and he rushed to his right and dived to intercept the ball
good length delivery, moving in towards off stump, tapped to the on side and Vinay gets across to pick the ball
goes for a seemingly pre-determined pull shot to a delivery outside off and edges it to the on side
full in length, in the channel outside off, again Tendulkar prefers to stay back, tries to dab it to point and the ball rushes past the outside edge
around the off stump line, Tendulkar goes back and across to defend to the off side
full in length, on the middle stump line, Tendulkar waited on the back foot and flicked it across the line from the middle through midwicket....
length delivery on the off stump line, pushed towards mid-off for a quick single
slower, around 127 kmph, fullish, flicked away uppishly to fine-leg
full in length, around 148 kmph, around the off stump line, pushed out to the off side
short in length, moving away from the left-handed batsman, squeezed out to backward point
full in length, on the middle and leg, turned behind square-leg for a single
the bouncer just down the leg side and Uthappa leaps to grab it
charges down the track and attempts to heave to the on side .. it was a slower one and he couldn't' adjust in time.. the ball rolls off his pad
Tendulkar shapes to pull but realises that the delivery was leaving him and outside off - tries to get the bat out of the way and the ball runs off the bat-face to point
in the zone outside off, the batsman tries to late cut it and is beaten
around the middle and off line, squeezed out to backward point
goes back and across to tap the length delivery wide of midwicket for a single
Thrash. Short in length and outside off stump, Tendulkar pressed back to force it to through cover point
leans forward to play a whippy flick .. it was a full length delivery on the leg stump line, flicked away to the boundary
short in length, outside off stump, slower one, around 115 kmph, Tendulkar mistimes the cut shot to the off side
146.2 kmph length delivery curving in towards the off stump, pushed out to the off side
around 142 kmph outswinger, Tendulkar pushes it to right of mid-off where Kumble makes a tumbling stop
leans forward to tap the ball towards extra cover for a single
fullish, just outside off, Tendulkar square drives and Ross Taylor makes a diving stop to his left
length delivery outside off stump, curves away, left alone
the first ball is on a length around off stump, guided to third man.
moves outside the leg stump and thrashes it to the cover boundary
moves outside leg, McLaren follows him , jabbed to the off side
just short of the blockhole, turned past midwicket
leans forward to play the off drive
length delivery n the middle, pushed to right of backward point for a single
bouncer outside off, Kumble tries to upper cut it but makes no contact
Pollard keeps getting them with his slower ones. Full in length and outside off and Pankaj miscues it towards mid-off
slower one again, full, pushed to long-off
length delivery outside off, pushed out to cover
outside off stump, dabbed to short third-man region
yet another slower one, goes through to the keeper
The slower off cutter gets him. He top edges the intended big hit to the keeper
banged in short on the middle, Virat moves outside leg and pulls it to the midwicket boundary
fullish, on the middle, swung to deep midwicket region
slower one, on the middle, tapped to the on side
moves outside leg and tries to pull the short delivery but again no contact
short in length and outside off, tries to cut it to third man but can't connect
slower one on the middle, swung away to deep midwicket
full pitched outside off, square driven to sweeper cover
full length delivery on the off stump line, pushed to the off side for a single
another one bouncing into the body and again Virat is in trouble, stabs it out to the on side
short delivery on the leg and middle, jabbed away to the on side
full pitched on the pads, rolls away behind square-leg
banged in short, Virat seemed to have lost sight of the ball, he was shaping to duck before he stabbed it away behind point
Length delivery outside off and Virat smashes it on the up and over mid-off
full delivery, pushed out to the on side
Yorked! Full, straight, pacy and Steyn tries to dig it out but no wood on leather. The ball squeezes past the bat and crashes into the leg stump
full delivery, pushed back to Zaheer
full and outside off, sliced away to deep point region
full pitched on off and middle and Kohli smashes it to the straight boundary
That swat flick again. He plays it really neatly. It was teh fullish delivery on middle and leg and Virat Kohli plays a stylish bottom-hand powered swat-flick to square-leg boundary
banged in short, stabbed to fine-leg region
moves outside leg, Fernando hurls it full outside off, Kohli can't connect

Done in by the slower one. Taylor clears the front foot and goes for a big swing to the on side but find more height than distance. Harbhajan moves in from deep midwicket to take it. He then tosses the ball in the air and kicks it off his boot. Bangalore slid further into abyss
slower one outside off, jabbed to third man
Fab hit. It was a full delivery on the middle, Virat gets the bottom-hand working time and lifts the ball over wide long-on
slower one outside off, Kohli goes for an expansive slog-swing to the on side but misses it completely
another one, really full, pushed out through wide mid-on region
full delivery just outside off, off driven to long-off
fullish, on the middle, hit hard down the pitch and Zaheer makes a half-stop
really full delivery, pushed towards long-on
goes for the yorker, steered past point for a single
moves outside leg stump and then reaches out to mistime the off drive towards long-off
from over the wicket, third consecutive near-yorker to Taylor who stabs it out
on the leg stump line, turned behind square-leg
from over the wicket for Rossy, full delivery, driven to Pollard at long-on
from round the stumps now, low full toss, swatted to deep midwicket
from over the wicket, a really full delivery, almost yorker length, jabbed past point
on the middle stump line, from round the stumps, eased to long-on for a single
bouncer around off stump line, pulled down past square-leg for a single
slower one, short in length outside off, swatted past square-leg
full in length outside off, eased to cover
banged in short around off, pushed out to left of backward point
full in length outside off, hit to cover where Harbhajan fumbles
done in by the slightly slower one. It was around 123 kmph length delivery outside off and Robin mistimes the big hit to Nayar at long-off
quicker one, from round the stumps, skids on, pushed out to midwicket
from round the stumps now, on the middle, pushed to long-on
the straighter one, the ball held between the thumb and the forefinger, gets KP who moved down the track for the lofted drive but ended up slicing it towards long-off where Tiwary took a low catch.
on the leg stump line, nudged behind square-leg
from over the wicket now, full and outside off, square driven for a single
KP steps out of his crease and smashes the slow delivery over midwicket boundary. Crushed!
length delivery outside off, another slower one, edged to right of Tare .. who makes the stop
slower, full in length and outside off, eased down to long-on
tapped to backward point to Sachin and again they rush for the quick single.. Sachin fires the throw but misses
flicked away for a single
stays back to tap it to point region for a quick single
high bouncer outside off and Robin ducks
steps forward to drive it hard to long-off

nicely flighted slow loopy delivery, from round the stumps, Dravid was forced to wait on that front foot and he couldn't find elevation when he swung to the on side ...  KP jumps at short midwicket to grab it.
slower, on the off stump line, dabbed to short third man
Biff. Full delivery outside off and KP thrashes it to the straight boundary
goes down the track and off drives to long-off
goes back, opens-up his stance and pulls the ball but find midwicket
full delivery outside off stump, Dravid continues to edge to third-man boundary. He went for the square drive and edges it to the boundary
length delivery on the off stump line, edged to short fine-leg
slower one outside off stump, Dravid lunges out and ends up chipping it over the bowler
another slower one, on the middle stump line, flicked to deep midwicket
slower one, short of length outside off, cut to sweeper cover
Top edges to third man boundary! Dravid tried to pull a short-of-length delivery from around off stump line and gets a thick fat edge
short delivery, pulled to deep backward square-leg
outside off, pushed away to the off side
goes for the reverse sweep but doesn't connect
gets forward to work it to midwicket

Tare misses the stumping opportunity What a mess! It was a lovely flighted delivery that went on straight, from the round the stumps angle, and it dipped and went past KP who had stumbled out for the drive. But Tare doesn't collecf it cleanly
still from round the stumps, on the leg stump line, nudged to midwicket
from round the stumps, pushed through outside off, Dravid reaches out to dab to short third man
short in length, bouncing outside off, KP punches it past point
around off stump line, steered to third man
Kallis walks down the track and yorks himself. It was a really full delivery and it collides with the inside edge.
moves outside leg again, McLaren follows him with a slower one this time, Kallis makes no contact and the ball goes past the leg stump
moves outside leg, McLaren follows him and Kallis pushes it back down the pitch
full delivery outside off stump, inside edges the intended off drive to backward square-leg region
146 kmph yorker, Kallis just about manages to get his front foot out of the way and digs the ball out to the on side
banged in short, outside off, around 143 k mph, Manish backs away and tries to flat-bat it over mid-on but doesn't connect well. Zaheer moves back from mid-on to take a neat catch
around 131 kmph full delivery outside off stump, Manish clears the front foot and carves it over mid-off
banged in short outside off, Pandey tries to upper cut it but doesn't connect
full delivery, jabbed out to the on side
fullish outside off stump, slower one delivered from split-finger grip, first popularized by Craig McDermott, and Manish edges the slog shot just past the lunging keeper
on the off stump line, pushed out to short extra-cover region for a quick single
opens the bat-face to guide this to left of backward point for a single
Smashed! Length delivery on the off stump line and Kallis clears the front foot and thrashes it over long-on
bangs it in short on the leg stump line, pulled away for a single
moves outside leg ... Zaheer follows him with a bouncer and Kallis edges the pull to backward point
full pitched on the middle and off line, driven straight to mid-off
Kallis moves outside leg , its an yorker, pushed out to mid-off
full in length outside off, run down to third man
Big swing and a miss. It was a length delivery outside off stump and Manish tries to loft it over mid-on but makes no contact
banged in short and Manish pulls it to deep square-leg region
cuts in from outside off, on the off stump line, dabbed to third man
moves down the track, gets outside leg as well and lifts a full length delivery inside-out from the leg stump line over extra cover
in the zone outside off, Manish pushes at it with an angled bat and the ball rushes past the edge . Two very quiet overs for Bangalore.
climbs from short of length outside off, tapped towards backward point.
short in length, bouncing outside off, pushed out to the off side
on the off-stump line, Kallis plays it late to third man
leans forward to push it out to the off side
goes for the yorker, ends as a low dipping full toss, eased to mid-on
around the off stump, a length delivery, defended towards point for a single
back of length delivery straightening a touch around off, tapped towards right of mid-off for a single
short in length, slanted across Manish who jabs it to mid-off
around the off stump, edged to behind square-leg for two runs
in the zone outside off, Manish tries to carve it to point but can't connect
length delivery angling away from Manish who defends to cover
